name: Error & Navigation Pages
description: Custom 404 page, error boundary, and loading states for graceful user experience when routes are not found, components fail, or content is loading
acceptanceCriteria: Custom not-found page renders at /nonexistent-route with wedding-themed design and link back to home
Error boundary catches runtime errors and shows user-friendly message with retry option instead of white screen
Loading state renders for story page dynamic import with visible skeleton/spinner
All error/loading pages follow wedding palette and typography from globals.css
Error pages are mobile-friendly and match site aesthetic
pnpm lint, pnpm typecheck, pnpm build pass
notes: Next.js App Router provides not-found.tsx, error.tsx, and loading.tsx conventions. Use them. Error boundary must be a client component. Keep error UI simple and on-brand.
